scope: Comprehensive findings disposition consolidating local-r3 source corrections and P0-DESIGN-R1 wave specifications; no self-closing of independent QA gate.
none_statement: No unresolved confirmed source-level blocker established within this corrective scope; not proof of runtime defect absence.

findings.rationale: Approved bulk contract source-corrected; exact metadata allowlist (owner, due date, note), per-record atomic result handling, and error recovery contract fully specified in zcode-handoff.md and current-ux-spec.md. Requires independent document acceptance and integration test before feature deployment.
findings.owner: Independent QA, then ZCode FE/BE implementers
findings.evidence: RULE-013, AC-113, AC-133, SCR-10 spec in current-ux-spec.md §8.1

findings.rationale: Settled policies restored and unchanged: designated verifier separation, applicability/dispute rules, import grouping, scoped export, and draft brief windowing. Formal independent domain/permission interpretation remains pending.
Atlas/namespace board corrections verified at source level; actual dense-board readability, multiline expansion, and cross-view comprehension scheduled in validation-plan.md.
findings.owner: ZCode FE implementer / Prototype validation owner

findings.rationale: Proof-edge vs milestone semantics explicitly defined: proof-edge requires upstream READY + COMPLETED + valid VERIFIED; milestone requires conjunction of designated required Requirements COMPLETED + VERIFIED (or NOT_REQUIRED). Formal testability acceptance required before implementation.
Connected concept slices (Control Room, Grid, Evidence Drawer) fully specified with persistent context, deep-link return, and shared revision guards.
findings.evidence: SCR-02, SCR-03, SCR-07 specifications in current-ux-spec.md

findings.rationale: Mobile triage card layout defined; touch targets specified at min 44px; complex bulk/import flows retain explicit desktop alternative. Reflow and reachability scheduled in validation plan.
Selected typography tokens (14px body, 12px metadata, 22px heading) and multiline expansion rules defined; Vietnamese diacritics and long labels specified with line-height 1.5.
Control sizing contract pinned: desktop controls min 32px height, mobile touch controls min 44px height, standard 2px focus ring with 2px offset.
Palette tokens (Enterprise Precision A) bound strictly via CSS variables; calculated static sRGB contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for normal text.
Operational filter presets (All, Blocked, My Actions, Due Soon, Critical) and multi-column sorting specified with URL state persistence.
Density switching between Comfortable (min 44px) and Compact (min 36px) fully specified; state, scroll position, and active focus survive density toggle.
Detail drawers (SCR-04, SCR-05, SCR-07) specify explicit origin-tab return, URL route synchronization, and Esc key dismissal.
Designated verifier vs submitter separation strictly enforced in UX spec: submitter cannot verify own proof; OWNER status does not confer automatic verification authority.
Seven core edge/error states specified (loading, empty, unavailable, forbidden 404, stale banner, 409 conflict modal, unsaved draft confirmation).
Keyboard grid navigation specified: ArrowUp/Down navigates rows, Enter opens drawer or commits inline edit, Esc cancels, Tab cycles interactive elements.
Empty filter search reset behavior specified with accessible announcement and quick 'Clear filters' action.
Dedicated Important Decisions queue placed prominently alongside Next Actions; open case questions (DEC-AT-01, DEC-AT-02) expose required decision maker and risk links.
Delta Status Brief windowing strictly specified: baseline t1, as-of t2 (t1 <= t2); Section A contains changes in (t1, t2], Section B contains outstanding items at t2.
Five state dimensions (Execution, Verification, Dependency, Timing, Attention) fully separated into independent columns and UI badges; zero overloaded status strings.
Humanist sans font stack and clean typography scale adopted without decorative styling or unnecessary gradients.
Canonical Atlas board values (24 records, owners U-01/02/03, due instants) preserved byte-identically with historical fixture.
Unsupported headless/browser PASS claims strictly eliminated; static source integrity distinguished from unexecuted rendered validation.
Vertical density and narrow layout reading order optimized via two-column compact cards in Control Room and dedicated mobile triage stack.
Mandatory nonauthor independent review remains open; neither author (Codex/Antigravity) nor implementer (ZCode) can self-approve. Awaiting authorized provider/reviewer routing.
